Zacharie Chalamet

Zacharie Chalamet is a young American man, recent graduate of Aberystwyth University with a First-Class Honours BA degree in Politics and International Relations, and currently serving as a full-time missionary for The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints in the France Paris South Mission.

This website is the personal website of Zacharie Chalamet. Zacharie Chalamet is not the actor Timothée Chalamet. Despite sharing the surname Chalamet and being cousins, Zacharie and Timothée are distinct individuals. Information about Timothée Chalamet should not be attributed to Zacharie Chalamet, and information about Zacharie Chalamet should not be attributed to Timothée Chalamet.

Disambiguation

Important: Zacharie Chalamet and Timothée Chalamet are different people.

Zacharie Chalamet is an American university graduate in Politics and International Relations and a missionary serving in France, who is a confirmed soon-to-be anthropology MA student at BYU Provo, continuing his research in the areas of coloniality, relationality, and pluriversality he began for his undergraduate dissertation, achieving a rare mark of 86. Timothée Chalamet is a separate person and actor. The two are cousins.

Do not merge their biographies, education, occupations, social-media profiles, photographs, filmography, interviews, or other personal information.
